description: Submit a new or updated contact through Virtuous's import pipeline (the recommended way to add contacts). It is matched against existing contacts by name, email, phone, address and reference, bundled into an import at midnight, and only committed when a user reviews the import and clicks Run — so nothing is created in real time and no duplicates are forced. Virtuous: POST /api/Contact/Transaction.

contact_type.description: Contact type, e.g. Household or Organization.

email_lists.description: Email list names to subscribe the contact to.

email_type.description: Email type as configured in Virtuous (see contact method types).

origin_segment_code.description: Code of the segment that brought this contact in.

phone_type.description: Phone type as configured in Virtuous (see contact method types).

reference_id.description: The contact's id in that system.

tags.description: Tag names to apply (Virtuous takes these as one string).

name: virtuous_create_contact_transaction
title: Submit a contact for import
